EUDR Due Diligence Starter
Galaxy Forge Implementation Kit v1.0 (September 2026)

FILES
- eudr_due_diligence_starter_guide.pdf : main implementation guide
- eudr_due_diligence_starter_workbook.xlsx : Excel workbook (5 sheets)
- eudr_supplier_data_request_letter.docx : editable template
- eudr_gap_memo.docx : editable template
- eudr_scope_decision_note.docx : editable template

HOW TO USE: start with Quick Start (section 2 of the guide), then work the 14-day plan in section 9.
SUPPORT: email support for file/usage questions within 7 days of purchase.
